text.jp: 嘆きの島への出発は<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
Make sure to prepare well. You depart for the
Isle of Sorrows on <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
嘆きの島へは、今日出発するわ。
準備はいいかしら？
text.official_en:
Today's the day you depart for the Isle of Sorrows.
Are you prepared for your journey?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カイくんの大剣闘祭、順調に勝ち進んでいる
らしいけれど、やっぱり心配だわ……
text.official_en:
You're doing admirably in the Heroic Games, Cai.
But I still have to say that I worry about you.
text.real_en:
You're doing admirably in the Great Gladiatorial Festival, Kai-kun.
But I still have to say that I worry about you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
本当に、絶対に、無理はしちゃ駄目よ。
セントリオンにもよくお願いしておくわね。
text.official_en:
Please be careful, and don't push yourself too far.
I ask the same of Centurio too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
セントリオンとはうまくやれているかしら？
あれで、結構可愛いところもあるのよ？
text.official_en:
How are you getting along with Centurio?
He's quite adorable.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だって、カストールもセントリオンも
多少見た目が老けているかもしれないけれど、
text.official_en:
Yes, Castor and Centurio both look somewhat
older now in appearance, yet...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
単純に年齢でわたくしと比較したら、
みんな子供みたいなものじゃないかしら？
text.official_en: compared to my own age, they're still quite young.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……そうよね、よくよく考えてみれば、
わたくしたちってすごい歳の差婚よね……
text.official_en:
Yes, there was a rather large age gap between us, as
husband and wife...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
え？　わたくし？　生まれたのが確か
５５３年だから……今年で８９６歳かしら。
text.official_en:
You see, I was born in the year 553. That means this
year I'll be...896? Yes, 896.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、他人事じゃないのよ？　カイくんも
わたくしの血が半分は入っているのだから。
text.official_en:
But my age is nobody else's business, is it? Cai, you
must never forget that you are half of my blood.
text.real_en:
But my age is nobody else's business, is it? Kai-kun, you
must never forget that you are half of my blood.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
多分だけど……５００年くらいは
生きることになるのよ？
text.official_en:
You may well live for five hundred years, do
you understand?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……カイくんも、生きている間に
たくさんのいいことがあるといいわね。
text.official_en: Cai, I hope you know happiness in those years.
text.real_en: Kai-kun, I hope you know happiness in those years.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カイ、見て！
あそこの壁に、何か描かれているの！
text.official_en: Cai, look! There's something painted on that wall!
text.real_en: Kai, look! There's something painted on that wall!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダマスカル王国時代のものかしら。
近くに行って確認してみましょう！
text.official_en:
Do you think it was painted during the time of the
kingdom of Damascar? Let's take a closer look!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
このアム・ルーの光景……
あたし、一生忘れないと思うわ。
text.official_en: I'll never forget the sight of Ahm Lu as long as I live.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ひとつの国が滅ぼされるって、
こういうことなんだって、思ったから……
text.official_en: This is what a country looks like once it's destroyed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いやだなあ……何か、さっきから
誰かに見られてるような気がするんだけど……
text.official_en:
I've had the feeling for a little bit that we're
being watched.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
特に、人が入り込んでいる
様子はないみたいね……
text.official_en:
No one else is here—and I think that's been the
case for a long time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だけど……ここにも、
たくさんの亡者たちがいるのかしら……
text.official_en:
Still, I figure we've got good odds of finding risen
dead here.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まるで……街全体が森に
呑み込まれてしまったかのようです。
text.official_en: It's as if the forest swallowed the city.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
国が滅ぼされてからの長い歳月が、街の姿を
ここまで変えてしまったのでしょう。
text.official_en:
In the long years since the nation's destruction, the
forces of nature have taken over.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
アウロラさまは、ドレイクの財宝の正体に
心当たりがあるっておっしゃっていたけど……
text.official_en:
Your mom said that she had an idea about the
true nature of Drake's treasures.
text.real_en: Aurora-sama said she had an idea what Drake's treasure really was, but...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それって、どういうことなのかしら。
……なんだか、すごく気になっちゃうわ。
text.official_en: What do you think she meant?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カイ、準備ができ次第、
すぐに嘆きの島に出発しましょう！
text.official_en:
Let's go to the Isle of Sorrows as soon as
you're ready!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
神様から直々にお願いごとを
されちゃうなんて、なんだか緊張するね。
text.official_en:
I can't believe I'm doing a favor for a god. It's kind of
nerve-racking, really.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それにしても嘆きの島って……
一体どんなところなんだろうね。
text.official_en:
And what's this Isle of Sorrows about, anyway?
What the heck kind of place is it?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
よお、カイか。
ガブリエルの奴から聞いたぜ。
text.official_en: Hey, Cai. I've been hearing stories from Gabriel.
text.real_en: Hey, Kai. I've been hearing stories from Gabriel.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大剣闘祭……順調に
勝ち上がっていってるらしいじゃねえか。
text.official_en: Sounds like you're doing well in the Heroic Games.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カストール
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さすがは俺の息子だ。
こっちも鼻が高いってもんよ。
text.official_en: That's my boy. I'm proud of you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我が心、忠ならんと欲すれば仁ならず、
さりとて仁たらんと振る舞えば、忠は……
text.official_en:
I never weighed kindness less, but I always weighed
loyalty more...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……おや、御子どの。
これは失礼いたしました。
text.official_en: Oh! Cai. My apologies.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今のは、私が若い頃に本で知った、とある
人物の詠んだ詩の一節にございますよ。
text.official_en: I was just remembering a poem I read years ago.

text.jp: <NCA>深いと思う
text.official_en: <NCA>Think about it.

text.jp: <NCB>よくわからない
text.official_en: <NCB>Say you don't understand.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACA>おお、さすがですな。
御子どのにはこれの意味がわかりましたか。
text.official_en:
<ACA>You grasped the meaning right away, didn't you?
I'd expect nothing less of you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID

text.jp:
<ACB>ははは……仕方ありますまい。
私も意味を理解するのに、随分かかりました故。
text.official_en:
<ACB>Haha... That's the way of the world, I suppose. It
took me many years to understand it myself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
歳を重ねますと、昔は読み飛ばしていた箇所に
深い意味を感じるようになるのです……
text.official_en:
The more years we acquire, the more we understand
deep meanings in passages we used to skip over.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
後悔などせぬままに生きることができるなら
……それが一番よい事なのかもしれませぬ。
text.official_en:
The most important thing of all, perhaps, is that you
live life in such a way that you have no regrets.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わたしは本で読んだ程度の知識
しか持ってないのだけれど……
text.official_en:
What I know about our destination all comes
from books.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
嘆きの島というのは確か、キュベレー郡の
沖にある島だったはず。
text.official_en: The Isle of Sorrows is just off the coast of Cybele.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
カリスト郡にあるアウロラ神殿の本殿
からならば、キュベレー郡は目と鼻の先よ。
text.official_en:
And Cybele's within spitting distance of Callisto's
primary temple of Aurora.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だけど………………
あのあたりの土地は、もう……
text.official_en: As for the lands in that area... *sigh*
